title: Java Backend Engineer
tagline: Java + Spring Boot + Kafka + System Design
description: The path for backend roles in Java: the language and its concurrency model, Spring Boot, databases, microservices, Kafka, then the system design scenarios interviewers ask at SDE-2 level.

steps.title: Core Java
steps.why: Collections, concurrency, the JVM and exceptions: the base every Java interview starts with.

steps.title: Spring Boot
steps.why: Auto-configuration, dependency injection, transactions and REST.

steps.title: SQL and databases
steps.why: Joins, indexing, transactions and query tuning.

steps.title: Microservices
steps.why: Service boundaries, resilience, sagas and data consistency.

steps.title: Kafka and messaging
steps.why: Partitions, consumer groups, delivery guarantees and failure handling.

steps.title: System design scenarios
steps.why: Design a feed, a rate limiter, a payment system: scale, caching and trade-offs.

steps.title: Low-level design
steps.why: Design patterns and class design for the machine-coding round.

steps.title: Behavioral
steps.why: Ownership and decision stories for the final rounds.

steps.title: React
steps.why: Hooks, rendering, state, performance and testing.

steps.title: Angular
steps.why: If your target teams use Angular: components, RxJS and change detection.

steps.title: Node.js
steps.why: The runtime behind tooling, SSR and backend-for-frontend services.

steps.title: Low-level design
steps.why: Patterns and component design.

steps.title: System design scenarios
steps.why: Large-scale design rounds, including front-end heavy products.

steps.title: Behavioral
steps.why: Collaboration and ownership stories.
